notes.title: The 3rd hotfix is now live!
notes.notes:
3rd Hotfix is now out!

Patch Notes
- Password-protected servers.
- Fixed game being randomly unresponsive/crashing when riding Polaris and some retro sleds. Probability was highest when riding north/east on Woodland or High Peaks.
- Utility sleds balancing.
- Skis were not turning for other players in multiplayer.
- When cancelling the spawn point removal by enter/gamepad player was spawned to the spawn point.
- Snow trail reacts to turning skis.
- When hosting or joining a multiplayer game on the same map, the environment ambience sounds were stopped.
- Spawn points cannot be placed in water anymore.
- Few watchtowers did not have colliders.
- Removed visual duplicate rear suspension parts from Shredders.
- Train in High Peaks had the wrong mesh profile and allowed getting under it.
- Corrected Kitty stats bars.
- SKS minor visual fix.

notes.title: Exciting Sledders News! 😮
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We’re thrilled to share some of the latest developments from the Sledders team.

𝐂𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐍𝐞𝐰𝐬: Big news! We've got Sledders running smoothly in our test environments, and we're hopeful about expanding to more platforms soon. While we can’t promise specific details yet, we're working hard to make Sledders accessible on next-gen platforms like PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. We'll hope to bring you good news soon. 

𝐂𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐔𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬: We’re in ongoing discussions with major snowmobile manufacturers and keeping a close watch on Arctic Cat's situation, hoping for the best outcome. We would love to have all snowmobile brands in the game. 

𝐆𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: We’re rolling out new features you’ve all been asking for. Get ready for smoother rides, exciting new maps, and fresh sleds to test out. Plus, we’re updating our game sounds with real engine sounds and GGB cans. We’re also polishing the UI to make it cleaner and more user-friendly for everyone.

𝐀 𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐎𝐆 𝐏𝐚𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐬: We are so grateful to those who have supported us from the start. We plan to honor you by including your names in the game credits. You’ll be able to choose how you’d like your name to appear—whether it’s your real name, a nickname, or a gamer tag. Look out for a message from us over at Patreon soon on how to submit your choice.

Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. Keep your feedback flowing. We'll continue to develop Sledders and improve your gameplay experience even after we have released full version. 
Stay warm, and let’s enjoy another thrilling season together!

Best regards,
𝘚𝘭𝘦𝘥𝘥𝘦𝘳𝘴 𝘛𝘦𝘢𝘮

[b]Hello Sledders Community,

The first snow blankets in Finland are starting a new snowmobile season. We're thrilled to announce that our latest update is now live! 

Big November Update to Enhance Your Sledding Experience:

[list]
[*] Getting Stuck Mechanism
[*] New Spawning Mechanism
[*] Revamped Garage
[*] Expanded Character Customization
[*] Female Driver Option
[*] Cinematic Camera Zoom
[*] In-Game Chat

[h2]Updated Release Schedule for Sledders 1.0 and Console Versions

We are confident these new features will make your gameplay even more interesting. We hope this tides you over as we put the finishing touches on what we believe will be a fantastic release in February. We keep working our asses off.

[list]

notes.title: Slush Season is Here! 🌨️ 1st Major Update for Sledders Now Live! 🌨️
notes.notes:
Yo, Sledheads!

We're thrilled to announce the first major update since the release of Sledders! This update is packed with features that will transform your sledding experience, taking it to new heights – literally and figuratively.

What's New:
[list]
[*] Trails are here! Yes, indeed. We brought trails to Sledders. This addition required us to develop an entirely new physics model tailored for trail riding. Riding on hard-packed snow trails is different compared to plowing through deep snow.
[*] Roads! With road come… drumroll, please… DITCH BANGING! Prepare to take your sled airborne!
[*] New sleds on the block! We're expanding your garage with several new sleds, including an innovative design featuring a single rail.
[*] Customization options! Make your sled look like you want. Choose from a variety of C&A Pro skis, available in different colors, along with ROX Speed handguards and bar pads to make your sled truly yours.
[/list]

All these features debut with our new map, High Peaks. Challenge yourself with its tough lines and steep climbs, designed to push your skills to the limit.

We're eager to hear your thoughts on this update. Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve the Sledders experience. Let us know what you love, what you don't, and what you hope to see in the future.

Stay frosty and shred hard!

notes.notes:
Hi Sledders,

Hold onto your helmets! The moment we've all (AND I MEAN ALL OF US) been itching jus got the date! Get ready to throttle up because an update for Sledders is roaring onto the stage on March 29th, bringing some ditches to bang and more snow to plow through.

After a lot of buzz and your downright requests, we're stoked to spill the beans on the official release date for the update. We're keepin' the best bits under wraps for now, but rest assured, we've been tuning this baby up with all your shouts, whoops, and hollers in mind.

[b]Here's a sneak peek at what you can expect on March 29th:
[/b]

notes.title: Community Spotlight ExHiiBiT
notes.notes:
[h2]Meet Josh, AKA ExHiiBiT
[/h2]
Hey, everyone! I'm Josh, also known as [b]ExHiiBiT[/b], and I've been on this journey of content creation for about three years now. While my YouTube channel has videos dating back to 2016, it wasn't until the Covid hit that I went all in. Working from home freed up a lot of my time, and here we are! I've found my niche in the motorsports genre, with [b]Motocross taking center stage[/b]. Creating content was a dream of mine. It's fascinating how life takes unexpected turns.

notes.title: Sledders Development Roadmap 2024
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is an overall view of the 2024 Roadmap and a few words on where we are heading with Sledders.

Nothing is written in stone, and we keep evolving and finding the best features for this unique snowmobiling game. We want to keep the community close and do our best.

That said, it is 100% certain that not all feature requests from the community will end up in the game. Some ideas are too time-consuming and will probably take many years to develop. Still, the Sledders community is a crucial source of inspiration, and all ideas are welcome.


[h3]So, what are we going to do with the game?
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Physic fine-tuning, Re-work on Skis and front suspension
[*] Character development, Female driver, Transition animations, Possibility to hop-over when side-hilling
[*] Gameplay features - Singleplayer & Multiplayer; Progressive gameplay, Explore and Unlock items, Challenge your friends in different multiplayer modes.
[*] New Garage/Garage UI; Character/Sled customization -> Parts & Tuning, Stats, Wraps, Outfits
[*] Level/map development
[*] Compacted snow / Hard surface driving -> Snowcross, Trails, Jumps
[*] Sound development
[/list]

We are looking forward to making this the best snowmobiling gaming experience there ever has been. We will showcase new features in the future.

After the core game is ready we will look into mod support. This will probably take place in 2025. 

Stay tuned for updates! The game will improve through the year 2024!

notes.title: Sledheads Rejoice: Realistic Snowmobiling Game is Coming Out This Winter
notes.notes:
The world’s first realistic snowmobile simulator [b]Sledders [/b]is coming out this winter on PC. Hanki Games and Bonus Stage from Finland are bringing the ultimate deep snow freeriding experience out soon, and you can wishlist it on Steam now.

The game has been in pre-alpha for a few months now, and its active, 20,000-strong Discord community has most recently gone wild for the brand new rider character which dropped along with the latest update. 

[previewyoutube=yw9QRWFq0-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Sledders was born from the needs of a snowmobile enthusiast [b]Niko Autio[/b], the founder of Hanki Games. [i]“Even here in Finland it’s not always snowy so to enjoy my freeriding hobby every season, I had to make a game about it”[/i], he describes as the moment of the birth of the game.

Well, Finns may not have snow all the time, but it does not stop them from having an annual snowmobiling world championship competition in the middle of the summer - they just drive them on water then. But for all who still prefer not to let their sleds sink in lakes, Sledders will offer a perfect environment for powdery practice outside the official season.

Sledders is based in realistic physics of the snowmobiles and snow. It means it’s technical and not an easy arcade experience, but it will offer the player a good learning experience and realistic feels of riding in snow. You steer by leaning and shifting the rider’s weight around, and you can quickly sink into the deep powder if you rev the engine too much!

Sledders will feature huge maps for players to ride around in. And just like riding in real life, it is designed to be a multiplayer experience. The developer is teasing possible missions and unlockables in the game, but the main element will be riding with friends in beautiful winter scenery.

The maps contain steep hills, mountains, arrays of trees, and vast valleys to surf the snow in. Conquer the mountains and reach the peak faster than your fellow riders. The limits are only set by the player so show us what you can accomplish!


[b]About Hanki Games[/b]
Indie game studio based in Kuopio, eastern Finland, which was born out of the need of its founder’s snowmobiling hobby to be continued in summertime. The studio employs currently two people in addition to its founder, and hopes to grow with Sledders as a prominent Finnish development house.

[b]About Bonus Stage[/b]
Bonus Stage is a lovable indie publisher from northern Finland. Among their released titles you can find gems like Dreams in the Witch House, Garden In!, Sunblaze, and now Sledders. Their adrenaline-hunting founders spend 99% of their winters in deep snow.


Official website: https://www.sleddersgame.com/
